description.zh:
视频文件起始偏移值。单位：毫秒。

><notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
></notice>

>大于0，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间作为开始读取的位置。
description.en:
The start offset of the video file. Unit: milliseconds.

><notice>

This parameter is valid only if the video source is a video file.

></notice>

> A value greater than 0 specifies the start time to read the file. The time is an offset from the first frame.

description.zh:
导播台ID。
- 如果您通过[CreateCaster](~~2848009~~)接口创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId returned in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the console, find the ID on the **Cloud Production Studio** page. To go to this page, choose **LIVE Console** > **Production Studio**.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is its ID.

description.zh:
仅对文件视频有效。单位：毫秒。 
         
- 大于**0**时，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间为结束读取的位置。
- 小于**0**时，表示相对于最后一帧的偏差时间作为结束读取的位置。
description.en:
This parameter is valid only for video files. Unit: milliseconds.

- If the value is greater than **0**, it specifies the end time to read the file. The time is an offset from the first frame.

- If the value is less than **0**, it specifies the end time to read the file. The time is an offset from the last frame.

description.zh:
媒资库图片素材ID。
>当视频源类型为图片时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
description.en:
The ID of the image material in the media asset library.

> This parameter is required only if the video source is an image.

description.zh:
图片素材URL。
>当视频源类型为图片且图片文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。支持上传jpg、png格式图片，最大文件不可超过10M。
description.en:
The URL of the image material.

> This parameter is available only if the video source is an image that has not been imported to the material library. The image must be in JPG or PNG format, and its size cannot exceed 10 MB.

description.zh:
直播流地址。

><notice>当视频源类型为直播流时，本参数才可用且必传。
></notice>
description.en:
The URL of the live stream.

><notice>

This parameter is required only if the video source is a live stream.

></notice>

description.zh: PTS回调间隔。单位：毫秒，仅对点播素材有效。
description.en: The Presentation Time Stamp (PTS) callback interval. Unit: milliseconds. This parameter is valid only for VOD materials.

description.zh:
仅对文件视频有效，表示播放完后重复继续播放的次数。 
         
- **0**（默认值）：表示不重复播放。
- **-1**：表示一直循环重复。
description.en:
This parameter is valid only for video files. It specifies the number of times to loop the video after playback is complete.

- **0** (default): The video does not loop.

- **-1**: The video loops indefinitely.

description.zh: 资源ID。如果您通过[AddCasterVideoResource](~~2848020~~)接口添加导播台视频源，请查看AddCasterVideoResource接口调用返回的参数ResourceId值。
description.en: The resource ID. If you add a video source to the production studio by calling the [AddCasterVideoResource](~~2848020~~) operation, use the ResourceId returned in the response.
The name of the video source.

description.zh:
点播文件地址。
><notice>当视频源类型为文件视频且视频文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。
></notice>
>点播文件仅限MP4、FLV、TS格式。
description.en:
The URL of the video on demand (VOD) file.

><notice>

This parameter is available only if the video source is a video file that has not been imported to the material library.

></notice>

> VOD files must be in MP4, FLV, or TS format.

descriptions.zh:
先通过[CreateCaster](~~2848009~~)接口创建导播台，再调用本接口修改导播台视频资源。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before calling this operation, you must create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation.

## QPS limit

This operation supports up to 10 queries per second (QPS) per user. If you exceed this limit, your API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live modify-caster-video-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --resource-id 05ab713c-676e-49c0-96ce-cc408da10000 --resource-name test001 --live-stream-url rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/caster/4a82a3d1b7f0462ea3734836620100000auth_key=1608953344-0-0-ac8c628078541d7055a170ec59a50000 --material-id f080575eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --vod-url http://developer.aliyundoc.com/AppName/StreamName.flv --begin-offset 0 --end-offset 10000 --repeat-num 0 --pts-callback-interval 2000 --image-id a089175eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --image-url http://learn.aliyundoc.com/AppName/image.jpg --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live ModifyCasterVideoResource --region cn-hangzhou --BeginOffset 0 --MaterialId f080575eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --ResourceName test001 --RepeatNum 0 --ImageUrl 'http://learn.aliyundoc.com/AppName/image.jpg' --LiveStreamUrl 'rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/caster/4a82a3d1b7f0462ea3734836620100000auth_key=1608953344-0-0-ac8c628078541d7055a170ec59a50000' --PtsCallbackInterval 2000 --VodUrl 'http://developer.aliyundoc.com/AppName/StreamName.flv' --EndOffset 10000 --ResourceId '05ab713c-676e-49c0-96ce-cc408da10000' --ImageId a089175eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --CasterId 'LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000'
